input.text: In Regulation (EU) 2019/1020, Article 14 of this Regulation applies.

_note: 'Article 14 of this Regulation' is EXPLICITLY self-named right after the citation, so it overrides the surrounding chapeau (which names a DIFFERENT instrument, Regulation (EU) 2019/1020) and stays INTERNAL. This is independent of the semicolon-boundary fix -- there is no semicolon here at all.
